_comment: WalkCroach Chrome — managed-install SAMPLE (NFR-C08). Read enterprise/README.md before applying; it explains two settings that were wrong in the previous version of this file. Replace EXTENSION_ID_REPLACE_ME with the ID the Chrome Web Store assigns on first publish (see chrome/VERSIONING.md).

oljdeopppkgfjeoobgochpddchlhmeaj._comment_hosts: Leave both empty unless you intend to bound page access. runtime_allowed_hosts is an ALLOWLIST of sites the extension may interact with — setting it to the API and web domains, as an earlier version of this file did, prevents WalkCroach from reading any page the user allows, which disables the product. runtime_blocked_hosts takes precedence and is the safer tool.
